title: Canonicalize ordered headers and redact credentials
instruction: Harden redact_headers(headers, sensitive=()) as an ordered canonical serializer. headers is a list of two-item string pairs. Names must be non-empty ASCII HTTP token strings and values must contain no control characters. Canonicalize names to lowercase, preserve pair order, and reject duplicates after canonicalization. sensitive is a duplicate-free list, tuple, or set of valid names; authorization, cookie, and set-cookie are always sensitive. Replace every sensitive value with [REDACTED], return fresh tuples in a fresh list, validate the entire input before output, and never mutate caller data. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-4 serialization/redaction lineage with ordered pairs, canonical aliases, defaults, and injection rejection.
